mapper.select: select lot_id, lot_no, row_ver from lot_master where lot_id = #{lotId} for update
mapper.sql: h.hold_id, h.lot_id, h.source, h.ref_id, h.reason_cd, h.reason, h.held_at, h.held_by, h.released_at
mapper.select: select from lot_hold h where h.lot_id = #{lotId} and h.source = #{source} and h.released_at is null and h.ref_id is not distinct from #{refId}::bigint for update
select from lot_hold h where h.hold_id = #{holdId}
insert into lot_hold (comp_cd, lot_id, source, ref_id, reason_cd, reason, held_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{lotId}, #{source}, #{refId}, #{reasonCd}, #{reason}, #{by}) returning hold_id
mapper.update: update lot_hold set released_at = now(), released_by = #{by}, release_reason = #{reason} where hold_id = #{holdId} and released_at is null
mapper.select: select from lot_hold h where h.lot_id in #{id} and h.released_at is null order by h.lot_id, h.held_at, h.hold_id
